item.title: 100% tariffs on India? Russia sanctions bill passed by US House; awaits Trump’s sign
item.description: The US House has successfully passed a sanctions bill aimed at Russian officials and the energy sector. This new legislation empowers President Trump to impose tariffs on significant buyers of Russian oil. India might encounter a staggering 100 percent tariff on its imports due to its energy dealings with Russia. The bill also broadens sanctions against Russia and prolongs measures against Iran for an additional five years.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: ‘We’re the best credit’: Trump fumes after 1st Fed rate hike in over 3 yrs
item.description: The Federal Reserve has set a new target range by increasing its benchmark interest rate, marking its first hike since 2023. President Donald Trump has called for a substantial reduction in interest rates, advocating for lower borrowing costs given the country's robust credit status. However, officials have stated that ongoing inflation remains a significant factor driving this adjustment.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Govt lowers export levies on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel
item.description: India's government has reduced export levies on petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel. The revised rates for these petroleum products took effect from September sixteenth. Export duty on petrol decreased by one rupee to zero point five rupees per litre. Diesel export levies were lowered by five rupees to twenty rupees per litre. These changes reflect a reversal of higher rates implemented earlier this month.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Why Mark Zuckerberg's wife's school was shut down despite $125 million in donations,
item.description: After ten years in operation, Priscilla Chan's Primary School in East Palo Alto has shut down. Supported by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school was designed to provide essential services for low-income families. However, despite substantial funding, student outcomes frequently lagged behind state benchmarks. As the initiative pivots towards scientific research, this closure illustrates the difficulties faced by philanthropic educational endeavors.

item.title: Meta admits mistake, to alert authorities on child sexual abuse material
item.description: The government is urging Meta to take more accountability for the online content shared on its platform. Following acknowledged shortcomings, Meta risks the loss of its intermediary safe harbour immunity. The company is now mandated to promptly report any instances of child sexual abuse material to the relevant authorities. The NCPCR highlighted that this safe harbour protection is conditional, not guaranteed.

item.title: Saudi in need, friend Pak missing in 'deed': Islamabad faces ultimate Mecca pact test
item.description: Saudi Arabia said on Wednesday that it had intercepted a Houthi drone heading towards Mecca, calling the security of Islam's holiest city a 'red line'. The Houthis flatly denied targeting Mecca and, in the same round of escalation, claimed to have shot down a Saudi F-15 fighter jet over Yemen's Marib province, a claim Riyadh has not confirmed.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: 'Spider-Man' beats 'Star Wars' to become highest-grossing film in North America
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has now become the highest-grossing film domestically. It surpassed Star Wars: The Force Awakens' long-standing box office record. The film has grossed approximately USD 936.773 million in North America. Globally, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has earned around USD 2.45 billion. Marvel Studios and Sony plan future releases for the franchise.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Matt Holliday’s 62-acre Oklahoma estate asks $9.8 million
item.description: Former MLB star Matt Holliday's luxurious estate in Oklahoma has hit the market, boasting 62 acres of prime land including a private baseball field with professional-grade lighting. The stunning home, constructed in 2022, offers five spacious bedrooms and seven bathrooms. Among the standout features are a magnificent swimming pool and an indoor sports court. Originally listed for $12 million, it is now available for $9.8 million.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Teen cancer survivor donates 573 Lego figures to hospital that treated him
item.description: Cancer survivor Alexander Ackles-Dold reminisces about the compassion he received during his childhood hospital stays. In a heartfelt initiative, he spearheads a LEGO donation drive for the pediatric oncology clinic in Southlake. The project has amassed hundreds of LEGO figures and raised considerable funds, striving to offer young patients an engaging escape during their treatments. The Ackles-Dold family continues to gather donations to brighten the spirits of children battling cancer.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Elon Musk’s Starlink mobile plan should be ‘laughed out of the room’, says T-Mobile CEO
item.description: T-Mobile's CFO Peter Osvaldik has raised concerns about the practicality of Starlink in the mobile sector, citing challenges posed by satellites in urban landscapes. He emphasizes the difficulties in deploying numerous small cell stations as envisioned by SpaceX. While Starlink aspires to bridge mobile service gaps in remote locations, T-Mobile sees significant obstacles in supplanting current cellular infrastructure, deeming it an uphill battle.

item.title: Simone Biles’ $3M mansion: Why did she build her Texas dream home?
item.description: Simone Biles and Jonathan Owens’ Texas lakefront mansion is finally complete after years of planning, approvals and construction delays. The couple started designing the home in 2020 and finished it in November 2025. The reported $3 million property includes a private gym, pool, sports court, large kitchen, spa-style bathroom, laundry room and a dedicated space for their dogs.

item.title: Rafael Nadal vs Maria Francisca Perello net worth: Who is richer in 2026?
item.description: Rafael Nadal and Maria Francisca Perello have built a financially successful household in different ways. Nadal’s fortune is still considerably larger, thanks to tennis prize money, endorsements, investments and businesses built during and after his playing career. Perello has taken a lower-profile professional route, including work related to the Rafa Nadal Foundation, while supporting the family’s broader business and philanthropic pursuits.

item.title: Josh Duhamel turned 52 Minnesota acres into an off-grid family retreat
item.description: Actor Josh Duhamel has acquired a tranquil property in Minnesota, initially featuring just an old cabin. Over the years, he expanded the land to fifty-two acres, modernizing it with essential utilities like electricity and running water. This transformation has provided a beloved retreat for his family, where they can enjoy a range of outdoor activities, including leisure time by the lakeside with his son.

item.title: Trump praises PM Modi’s opium crackdown, but India stays on US drug transit list
item.description: President Trump welcomed Prime Minister Modi's efforts to curb opium poppy cultivation in India. Washington designated India among 23 countries as major drug transit or producing nations. This designation does not reflect a failure to tackle the drug trade by India. The US seeks continued cooperation with India under the Drug Policy Framework. Trump also urged China to strengthen action against precursor chemical flows.

item.title: US officials met Houthi leaders in Oman after Red Sea blitz, got assurances: Report
item.description: US officials reportedly met Houthi representatives in Oman on Sunday. The meeting occurred after Houthis occupied a significant portion of the Red Sea coast. Houthis affirmed no intention of attacking American vessels and committed to a 2025 ceasefire. They also stated they would not attack Israeli or commercial ships, except Saudi ones. This engagement follows months of negotiations and prior attacks on Red Sea shipping.

item.title: Washington couple spent $300,000 on home plans; state wants 44 acres surrendered
item.description: Tyler Chambers embarked on an ambitious journey to construct his dream home in Washington. Investing nearly $300,000 into regulatory requirements and necessary studies, he was soon met with neighbor complaints that triggered additional demands. These included extensive environmental assessments and a permanent conservation deed restriction on two-thirds of his land. Undeterred by the financial and emotional strain, Chambers remains resolute in his quest to build a home.

item.title: New Orleans turns 12 million pounds of glass into sand to rebuild wetlands
item.description: In a groundbreaking initiative in New Orleans, discarded glass bottles are being turned into sand for coastal restoration. Known as Glass Half Full, this program has successfully redirected millions of pounds of glass from local landfills. Current research is examining the positive impact of this recycled glass sand on the growth and durability of wetland vegetation, providing a creative solution to Louisiana's ongoing coastal land loss issues.

item.title: ‘Never met Disha Salian’: Aaditya Thackeray breaks silence on CBI FIR
item.description: Aaditya Thackeray denied meeting Disha Salian, calling allegations a false campaign. The CBI has registered an FIR into Salian's 2020 death following a court order. Salian died after falling from a building, and Sushant Singh Rajput died a week later. The investigation will examine evidence handling and potential official misconduct. Thackeray called for an impartial and fresh inquiry into the case.
